extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings; acting for respondent in divorce
extracted.summary: A family law solicitor enquires about a £42,500 litigation loan for a divorce respondent in financial remedy proceedings where roughly £394,000 of property and pensions is in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your client's financial remedy proceedings. We have noted the £42,500 requested and the approximately £394,000 of assets in dispute. To take this further, we would be grateful for confirmation of the jurisdiction and court, the stage of proceedings and any listed hearing dates, a breakdown of the costs to be funded, details of the assets offered as security, and client identification details. Our criteria and application form will follow, and a member of the team will be in touch once we have reviewed the information provided.
